authoring_publish_description: Publishing creates a version that can’t be changed. It doesn’t activate the workflow or give it access to anything. Activate it afterwards from the workflow page.
authoring_publish_limits_title: Can’t run in this workspace yet.

authoring_palette_limited: Can’t run in this workspace yet.

authoring_code_narrow: Code is read-only on small screens. Use a wider screen to edit it.

authoring_code_step_inputs_empty: No inputs or results from earlier steps yet.
authoring_code_step_grants_empty: To let this code request a read or action, place that step directly after this Code step.

authoring_start_subject_unset: Choose what the workflow acts on in the settings above.

authoring_settings_id_hint: Used in links. It can’t change after the first version is published.

authoring_describe_prompt_placeholder: When a SKU drops below 20 units, draft a purchase order for the usual supplier and ask me to approve it.
authoring_describe_pending: Drafting and checking the workflow. This can take up to a minute…
authoring_describe_failed: {error} Your description is kept so you can try again.
authoring_assistant_partial: Luma couldn’t fix every problem in the draft. The remaining problems are listed above.
authoring_proposal_no_changes: The instruction didn’t change the draft.

authoring_refine_placeholder: Also wait an hour before checking the result.
authoring_wait_for_save: Wait until your changes are saved.
authoring_suggest_placeholder: Order enough to reach the target, rounded up to whole boxes of 12.
authoring_gallery_description: Start from a template or build your own. Nothing runs until you publish and activate it.
authoring_gallery_view_only: You can browse templates. Your role doesn’t allow creating workflows or setting up templates.
authoring_templates_description: Ready-made workflows you set up and activate. Each one lists what it needs first.
authoring_templates_search_placeholder: Search by name or what it does…
authoring_templates_empty_description: Start from scratch below, or install an app that adds templates.

authoring_scratch_visual_description: Add steps one by one: read data, check conditions, take actions, ask for approval and check results.

authoring_use_done_description: The workflow is active where you chose.
authoring_use_missing: Finish the missing items first. The links on the template card open the right place.
authoring_use_activated: Activated. Runs start when the trigger happens. Each action still follows your workspace’s approval rules.
authoring_use_install_description: Luma first adds the reviewed version of this workflow to your workspace. Adding it doesn’t activate anything.

authoring_save_forbidden: You can no longer edit this draft

authoring_coordination_unavailable: This task is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
